method: Hash-matched official originals downloaded and rendered locally with Poppler; full-page visual inspection. Render images not retained.
observations: Building page 1 states January 1 2026 county effective date and 5% technology fee plus OBBS 1% RCO/3% OBC surcharge. This is county printed adoption wording, not confirmation of Reading's precise deduction.
Building page 3 separates fire alarm, OBC HVAC and RCO 1-2-3 dwelling schedules; no separate electrical permit route established.
Building page 4 separates CO, CC, TCO, processing, review, building appeal and penalty fees; building appeals must not be substituted for zoning BZA fees.
Zoning page 1 includes land/use/commercial occupancy change $25 and residential occupancy change $0; neither is a blanket sign permit exemption.
Zoning page 2 continues Residential accessory table: permanent sign in S column, $25 for S versus $40 for U/B. Commercial permanent sign $40 appears on page 3. Applicability/currentness pending.

BZA page 1 expressly includes Signs among variance categories, code sections, project detail, applicant/owner/location and zoning/design district choices. Form choices do not prove actual parcel zoning.
BZA page 2 requests five narratives: unique physical condition, alternatives, hardship, effects on neighbors and smallest variance.
BZA checklist requires scaled plans and names/addresses of ALL abutting owners, including across public/private rights-of-way; print/sign/date certification.

BZA form prints $150 cash/check payable City of Reading or credit card 3.5% fee. Because page 1 expressly requests variance, this does not resolve zoning schedule variance $250/admin appeal $150 conflict.
